@@ -1,61 +1,65 @@
 # Control flow structures in Crystal
 
-# If/elsif/else
-value = 42
-if value > 100
-  puts "Large"
-elsif value > 50
-  puts "Medium"
-else
-  puts "Small"
-end
+def demonstrate_control_flow
+  # If/elsif/else
+  value = 42
+  if value > 100
+    puts "Large"
+  elsif value > 50
+    puts "Medium"
+  else
+    puts "Small"
+  end
 
-# Unless
-unless value < 0
-  puts "Non-negative"
-end
+  # Unless
+  unless value < 0
+    puts "Non-negative"
+  end
 
-# Case/when
-case value
-when 0
-  puts "Zero"
-when 1..50
-  puts "Low"
-when 51..100
-  puts "Medium"
-else
-  puts "High"
-end
+  # Case/when
+  case value
+  when 0
+    puts "Zero"
+  when 1..50
+    puts "Low"
+  when 51..100
+    puts "Medium"
+  else
+    puts "High"
+  end
 
-# Loops
-i = 0
-while i < 3
-  puts i
-  i += 1
-end
+  # Loops
+  i = 0
+  while i < 3
+    puts i
+    i += 1
+  end
 
-# Until
-until i == 0
-  puts i
-  i -= 1
-end
+  # Until
+  until i == 0
+    puts i
+    i -= 1
+  end
 
-# For loop
-for x in [1, 2, 3]
-  puts x
-end
+  # For loop - using each instead
+  [1, 2, 3].each do |x|
+    puts x
+  end
 
-# Break and next
-[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].each do |x|
-  next if x == 2
-  break if x == 4
-  puts x
-end
+  # Break and next
+  [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].each do |x|
+    next if x == 2
+    break if x == 4
+    puts x
+  end
 
-# Ternary operator
-status = value > 50 ? "High" : "Low"
+  # Ternary operator
+  status = value > 50 ? "High" : "Low"
 
-# Logical operators
-if value > 10 && value < 100
-  puts "In range"
+  # Logical operators
+  if value > 10 && value < 100
+    puts "In range"
+  end
 end
+
+demonstrate_control_flow
